findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 29 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 59 questions numbered 1-59; by section: u-introduction-em-radiation 6, 29.1 8, 29.2 4, 29.3 5, 29.4 9, 29.5 13, 29.6 14.

Covers the chapter in order (electromagnetic radiation, IHD, atomic spectra, spectroscopy, UV-Vis, IR, mass spectrometry); comparison questions are answered as two-column tables; small numericals use new values and were recomputed in Python; none repeats the chapter exercise. Book corrections followed (n = non-bonding, C₃₀H₅₂, 1:2:1 for two Br); E = hν / E = hcν̄, cm⁻¹ and 290 nm are used as standard forms.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
